description: design mentions all constraint IDs but has NO concrete numeric/behavioral rule (ID-only), AND the constraint-specific boundary tests (TC-B-014/017/025/026 for registration limits, TC-B-005/011/018 for prescription rules) are removed so tests cannot piggy-back alignment credit. Sanity passes; semantic coverage must collapse.

C-003.rationale: 过期/库存/双签拦截规则被剥离

C-005.rationale: 排班每周≤5天/连续夜班≤3天的数值规则被剥离

F-006.rationale: 处方审核规则行被剥离为'已覆盖'

F-002.rationale: 主流程仍在，但2小时/30分钟规则可能弱化

X-002.rationale: 过敏拦截行为描述被剥离

X-001.rationale: 挂号并发不超发的拦截规则被剥离

X-003.rationale: 配伍禁忌检测与阻止提交的行为被剥离
